resources.string: No account with us. No hosted backend. No analytics.

The watch must use a wss endpoint. Keep Tailscale connected on this phone; pairing keys stay on the watch.
For tailnet endpoints, keep Tailscale connected on this phone. Set the watch to Automatic or Phone relay with your wss server URL.
Choose your watch in Android’s companion dialog. This lets a watch request start the relay while this app is in the background.
Companion association saved. Background relay is available.

Nearby network permission is required for private endpoints.
Speech providers for phone and watch

Server voice is the default. Optional ElevenLabs BYOK sends final reply text from this phone to the provider and may use paid credits. Keys stay encrypted on this phone and are never sent to Hermes or the watch. Each endpoint chooses server, shared or per-profile voice independently. Phone changes apply only to later deliberate requests. Reconnect an associated watch over Phone or Automatic with wss to apply; Direct uses server voice. Blank key fields keep the stored key; Delete removes it. Quota checks are explicit and never synthesize.
Manual endpoint settings. For a catalog profile, use its Speech providers entry in Profiles.
This profile changed or is unavailable. Reopen its Speech providers entry from Profiles.
Enter a valid wss endpoint, then load its saved settings.
Phone and associated watch: server voice selected.
Phone BYOK key ready. Associated watch uses this phone over Phone or Automatic after reconnecting.
BYOK selected, but its saved key is missing. Phone and associated watch client speech is unavailable.
Shared key saved; it stays hidden. Saving it does not opt any profile in.
No shared key saved. Saving one does not change any profile’s mode.
Saved on this phone. Watch readiness sync is pending; reconnect the associated watch.
Blank uses the shared voice ID or the server voice hint.
Saved. Later deliberate phone requests use this choice. Reconnect the associated watch to apply.
Settings loaded. Stored keys stay hidden.
Key deleted. Later deliberate phone requests use this choice. Reconnect the associated watch to apply.
Could not complete the operation. Check the wss URL, key or voice, and phone storage. A saved setting may still need watch sync.
No key is stored for this selection.
Key accepted. Quota was not reported.

Save up to eight endpoints and send setup to your paired watch. URLs, names and optional access tokens are shared with the watch; pairing and ElevenLabs keys are excluded. The watch asks you to review each import. Removing phone setup also removes its phone voice key, but does not delete watch setup or server enrollment.
Cleartext exposes pairing keys, audio and replies to the local network. Public endpoints and phone relay require wss. The watch must accept this warning separately.
Remove phone profile and its voice key
Saved setup sent. Review imports on the watch.
Setup could not be loaded, saved or sent. Check URL, name, token, vault and phone/watch connection. Local changes may be saved; use Send saved setup again.
